chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 320 – Han Li Passes Chen Qiaoqian’s Test, Loses a Sixth Brother Before Battle
chapter_meta_description: Chen Qiaoqian confronts Han Li one last time. He sends the Meng Mountain brothers away with gifts, and the squad discovers Wu Xuan has vanished. The night raid begins.
og_title: RMJI 320 – The Calm Before the Storm
og_description: A quiet chapter of interrogation, farewells, and a mysterious disappearance folds into the final moments before the assault on the Black Fiend Sect.
twitter_title: RMJI 320 – One Less to Count On
twitter_description: Han Li keeps his secrets, parts with the rogues, and learns a teammate is missing. All before the main event.

lore_anchors.definition: The first stage of cultivation, where a practitioner gathers and stabilizes spiritual qi within the body; the lowest formal rank in the cultivation hierarchy.
The second major cultivation realm, granting significantly longer life and higher combat power than Qi Condensation; considered true cultivators in the sect structure.
A mid-to-high-tier magic tool, several grades above ordinary tools but notably inferior to top-grade tools; often used as generous gifts among cultivators of different tiers.
A quadrennial high-mortality trial within a sealed forbidden land, where cultivators compete in a zero-sum resource hunt.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Chen Qiaoqian keep pressing Han Li about the Blood Forbidden Trial?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She is convinced Han Li is the one who killed her former fiancé during that trial and wants a confession or a slip of the tongue.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li give the Meng Mountain brothers superior-grade tools instead of better ones?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Giving top-grade tools to low-level cultivators could breed greed and suspicion; a generous but not extraordinary gift binds them in gratitude without creating new risks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Does the disappearance of Wu Xuan matter to the main plot?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It serves as a minor tactical complication and reinforces the Mortal Stream’s theme that characters often vanish without grand closure, especially when they are peripheral or stubborn.
